Write a LinkedIn outreach message for this candidate and role:

Name: Sofia Chen
Target role: ML Infrastructure Engineer (https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/xai/jobs/4834320007)
Location: San Francisco, CA | Timezone: PST
Seniority: senior | Domain: ml
Summary: ML infrastructure engineer with deep experience in distributed training systems and model optimization. Previously scaled training pipelines at Anthropic.
Skills: PyTorch, CUDA, Distributed Training, Model Optimization, Kubernetes, Python
Projects:
- Built distributed training framework supporting 1000+ GPU clusters
- Optimized model checkpointing reducing save times by 60%
- Designed fault-tolerant training pipeline with automatic recovery
Experience:
- Senior ML Infra Engineer @ Anthropic (2-3 years): Built distributed training framework supporting 1000+ GPU clusters; Optimized model checkpointing reducing save times by 60%.
- ML Engineer @ OpenAI (1-2 years): Designed fault-tolerant training pipeline with automatic recovery.
Education: MS Computer Science, Stanford
Openness: Open to new opportunities; prefers Bay Area
Job excerpt:
About xAI

xAI's mission is to create AI systems that can accurately understand the universe and aid humanity in its pursuit of knowledge. Our team is small, highly motivated, and focused on engineering excellence. This organization is for individuals who appreciate challenging themselves and thrive on curiosity. We operate with a flat organizational structure. All employees are expected to be hands-on and to contribute directly to the company's mission. Leadership is given to those who show initiative and consistently deliver excellence. Work ethic and strong prioritization skills are important. All engineers are expected to have strong communication skills. They should be able to concisely and accurately share knowledge with their teammates.

About the Role

We are looking for ML Infrastructure Engineers to build and scale our training systems. You will work on distributed training at unprecedented scale, optimizing performance across thousands of GPUs. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience with large-scale ML systems and a passion for pushing the boundaries of what's possible.

Write a personalized, professional message (under 150 words) that references their specific background and explains why this role might interest them.

Hi Sofia,

Your work on distributed training at Anthropic caught my attention—scaling to 1000+ GPUs while cutting checkpoint times by 60% is exactly the kind of systems thinking we need.

At xAI, we're pushing training infrastructure to scales that don't exist anywhere else yet. Your experience with fault-tolerant pipelines and GPU cluster optimization would directly impact how we train our next generation of models.

The role is hands-on technical work in a flat org—no layers between you and the problems. Given you're already in the Bay Area and open to new opportunities, the logistics are easy.

Would you have 15 minutes this week to hear about what we're building? I think you'd find the technical challenges genuinely novel.

Best,
[Recruiter]

Name: James Rodriguez
Target role: Backend Engineer - Grok API (https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/xai/jobs/4760806007)
Location: Austin, TX | Timezone: CST
Seniority: mid | Domain: backend
Summary: Backend engineer focused on high-throughput API systems. Experience building real-time services handling millions of requests per second.
Skills: Go, Rust, PostgreSQL, Redis, gRPC, Kubernetes, AWS
Projects:
- Designed rate limiting system handling 10M+ requests/minute
- Built real-time streaming API with sub-10ms p99 latency
- Migrated monolith to microservices architecture
Experience:
- Backend Engineer @ Stripe (2-3 years): Designed rate limiting system handling 10M+ requests/minute; Built real-time streaming API with sub-10ms p99 latency.
- Software Engineer @ Coinbase (1-2 years): Migrated monolith to microservices architecture.
Education: BS Computer Science, UT Austin
Openness: Open to relocation for the right opportunity
Job excerpt:
About xAI

xAI's mission is to create AI systems that can accurately understand the universe and aid humanity in its pursuit of knowledge. Our team is small, highly motivated, and focused on engineering excellence. This organization is for individuals who appreciate challenging themselves and thrive on curiosity. We operate with a flat organizational structure. All employees are expected to be hands-on and to contribute directly to the company's mission.

About the Role

We're building the API layer that powers Grok. You'll design systems that handle millions of concurrent conversations with strict latency requirements. Experience with high-throughput backends, real-time processing, and API design is essential. You'll work directly with ML teams to optimize the interface between models and users.

Write a personalized, professional message (under 150 words) that references their specific background and explains why this role might interest them.

Hi James,

Your streaming API work at Stripe—sub-10ms p99 at that scale—is the exact profile we're looking for on the Grok API team.

We're building the backend that serves millions of AI conversations in real-time. The latency and throughput challenges are genuinely hard: every millisecond matters when you're running inference at scale. Your rate limiting and microservices experience would translate directly.

I noticed you're open to relocation—we offer comprehensive packages to the Bay Area, and the team culture is very different from big fintech: smaller team, faster iteration, direct ownership of critical systems.

Stripe → AI infrastructure is a path several of our engineers have taken successfully. Would you be up for a quick call to discuss what the technical work actually looks like?

Best,
[Recruiter]

Write a LinkedIn outreach message for this candidate and role:

Name: Aisha Patel
Target role: Site Reliability Engineer (https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/xai/jobs/4922802007)
Location: Seattle, WA | Timezone: PST
Seniority: staff | Domain: infra
Summary: Staff SRE with expertise in large-scale Kubernetes deployments and GPU cluster management. Led reliability initiatives at Google Cloud.
Skills: Kubernetes, Terraform, Prometheus, GPU Scheduling, Linux, Python, Go
Projects:
- Architected GPU scheduling system for 50K+ accelerators
- Reduced cluster incident response time by 40% through automated remediation
- Built observability platform processing 1B+ metrics/day
Experience:
- Staff SRE @ Google Cloud (3-4 years): Architected GPU scheduling system for 50K+ accelerators; Reduced cluster incident response time by 40% through automated remediation.
- Senior SRE @ Microsoft Azure (2-3 years): Built observability platform processing 1B+ metrics/day.
Education: MS Computer Engineering, University of Washington
Openness: Considering opportunities with significant technical challenges
Job excerpt:
About xAI

xAI's mission is to create AI systems that can accurately understand the universe and aid humanity in its pursuit of knowledge. Our team is small, highly motivated, and focused on engineering excellence. This organization is for individuals who appreciate challenging themselves and thrive on curiosity. We operate with a flat organizational structure.

About the Role

We need SREs who can keep the world's largest GPU clusters running reliably. You'll own the infrastructure that trains our models—Kubernetes at a scale few have seen, with reliability requirements that push the boundaries of what's possible. Experience with GPU clusters and large-scale distributed systems is essential.

Write a personalized, professional message (under 150 words) that references their specific background and explains why this role might interest them.

Hi Aisha,

Managing GPU scheduling at 50K+ accelerator scale at Google Cloud is rare experience—and exactly what we need at xAI.

We're running one of the world's largest GPU clusters, and the reliability challenges are unlike anything else in the industry. Your automated remediation work and observability expertise would have immediate impact on how we keep training running.

I saw you're looking for significant technical challenges—this is genuinely that. The scale is larger, the problems are harder, and you'd have direct ownership in a flat org where your decisions matter.

The Seattle → Bay Area move is something we support fully with relocation packages. Several of our SREs made similar transitions from Google.

Would you have time for a brief call this week? I'd love to share specifics about the infrastructure problems we're solving.

Best,
[Recruiter]
